implementation.likedSongs: The canonical special playlist and collection/tracks aliases open the shared complete native collection snapshot. Removed entries and non-track entities are excluded. Newest additions appear first; metadata is loaded in pages of 50. The playback queue carries all collection identities, without eagerly requesting metadata or audio for unseen rows.
implementation.savedUpdates: Only acknowledged collection changes notify the entity and invalidate the Library join. Existing save/remove HTTP contracts and selected Accounts HTTP provider remain intact.
implementation.recentlyPlayed: The Library and Recently Played page share the independently captured fixed fifty-context native read and actual HTTP expiry. Existing metadata caches and loaded rootlist decorations are reused; uncached playlist reads use the captured RECENTLY_PLAYED caller in bounded pairs. Local display pages contain 20 cards and introduce no server cursor.
implementation.navigation: Liked Songs is available from the Library and profile menu. Both pages are local Command-K destinations, also searchable by liked, recently played and history, with no catalog request for these commands. These convenience entries are application UX, not a claim of original quick-search parity.
